questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x) = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{nx}{1 + 2^n \sin^{2n}(x\pi) + n(x - 1)} \)，则 \( f(x) \) 在区间 \( \left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{2}\right) \) 内的间断点个数为（）

solution.analysis_md:
先求极限：
\[
f (x) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} 2 ^ {n} \sin^ {2 n} (x \pi) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ 2 \sin^ {2} (x \pi) \right] ^ {n} = \left\{\begin{array}{l l}\infty , | \sin (x \pi) | > \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}\\1, | \sin (x \pi) | = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}\\0, | \sin (x \pi) | <   \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}\end{array}\right..
\]
在区间 \(\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{3}{2}\right)\) 内， \(\left|\sin (x\pi)\right| > \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\Leftrightarrow \frac{1}{2} < x < \frac{3}{4}\) 或 \(\frac{5}{4} < x < \frac{3}{2}\)
由于指数函数收敛的速度远高于幂函数，则当 \(\frac{1}{2} < x < \frac{3}{4}\) 或 \(\frac{5}{4} < x < \frac{3}{2}\) 时，\(f(x) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{nx}{1 + 2^n\sin^{2n}(x\pi) + n(x - 1)} = 0\)
当 \(\frac{3}{4} < x < \frac{5}{4}\) 时，\(f(x) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{nx}{1 + 2^n\sin^{2n}(x\pi) + n(x - 1)} = \frac{x}{x - 1}\)
不难检验，在 \(x = \frac{3}{4}\) 及 \(x = \frac{5}{4}\) 处 \(f(x)\) 的左右极限均不相同，可知 \(x = \frac{3}{4}\) 及 \(x = \frac{5}{4}\) 均为 \(f(x)\) 的间断点.
又由于当 \(\frac{3}{4} < x < \frac{5}{4}\)，\(f(x) = \frac{x}{x - 1}\)，可知 \(x = 1\) 也为 \(f(x)\) 的间断点，故选（D）.

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x) \) 可导, 且 \( f'(0) > 0 \), 若 \( \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{f\left(\int_0^x f(t) dt\right)}{\sqrt{1 + x^2 - \cos x}} = 1 \), 则 \( f'(0) = (\quad) \).

solution.analysis_md:
由于极限 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f\left(\int_0^x f(t)dt\right)}{\sqrt{1 + x^2} - \cos x}\) 存在，可知 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f\left(\int_0^x f(t)dt\right) = 0\) ，即 \(f(0) = 0\)
由于 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\int_0^x f(t)dt = 0\) ，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f \left(\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t\right)}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2} - \cos x}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f \left(\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t\right) - f (0)}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2} - \cos x}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f \left(\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t\right) - f (0)}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t - 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2} - \cos x}} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2} - \cos x}} = f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t}{1 + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) - \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)\right]} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t}{x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)} = f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) d t}{x ^ {2}} = f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{2 x} \\ = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (0) \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x - 0} = \frac {\left[ f ^ {\prime} (0) \right] ^ {2}}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
则有 \([f'(0)]^2 = 2\) ，又由于 \(f'(0) > 0\) ，可知 \(f'(0) = \sqrt{2}\) ，故选（B）.

questions.stem: 设函数 \( y = f(x) \) 由方程 \( x^{2}\cos x + x^{4} - 2y - y^{3} = \mathrm{e}^{y} \) 确定, 则 ( )

options.A: \(\int_0^x f(t)dt\) 为奇函数, \(\int_0^x f'(t)\sin tdt\) 为奇函数
options.B: \(\int_0^x f(t)dt\) 为奇函数, \(\int_0^x f'(t)\sin tdt\) 为偶函数
options.C: \(\int_0^x f(t)dt\) 为偶函数, \(\int_0^x f'(t)\sin tdt\) 为奇函数
options.D: \(\int_0^x f(t)dt\) 为偶函数, \(\int_0^x f'(t)\sin tdt\) 为偶函数

solution.analysis_md:
先判断  \( f(x) \)  的奇偶性：由题干可知  \( x^{2}\cos x + x^{4} = e^{y} + 2y + y^{3} \) .
假设 \( y = g(u) \) 是 \( u = e^{y} + 2y + y^{3} \) 的反函数，则有 \( y = f(x) = g\left(x^{2}\cos x + x^{4}\right) \).
则 \(f(-x) = g\left((-x)^2\cos (-x) + (-x)^4\right) = g\left(x^2\cos x + x^4\right) = f(x)\)，可知 \(f(x)\) 为偶函数.
下面判断两个变限积分的奇偶性: 由于 \(\left(\int_{0}^{x} f(t) dt\right)' = f(x)\), 且函数 \(y = \int_{0}^{x} f(t) dt\) 过原点, 可知 \(\int_{0}^{x} f(t) dt\) 为奇函数. 由于 \(\left(\int_{0}^{x} f'(t) \sin t dt\right)' = f'(x) \sin x\), 其中 \(f'(x)\) 为奇函数, 从而 \(f'(x) \sin x\) 为偶函数, 又由于函数 \(y = \int_{0}^{x} f'(t) \sin t dt\) 过原点, 可知 \(\int_{0}^{x} f'(t) \sin t dt\) 为奇函数.
综上所述，应选（A）.

questions.stem: 设 \( f(x, y) = \begin{cases} x^2 y \sin \left( \frac{1}{x^2 + y^2} \right), & (x, y) \neq (0, 0) \\ 0, & (x, y) = (0, 0) \end{cases} \)，则（ ）.

options.B: \(f(x,y)\) 在点 \((0,0)\) 处连续但不可微

solution.analysis_md:
由于  \( \sin\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\right) \)  有界，可知  \( \lim_{x\to0\atop y\to0}f(x,y)=\lim_{x\to0\atop y\to0}x^{2}y\sin\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\right)=0=f(0,0) \) . 则  \( f(x,y) \)  在点  \( (0,0) \)  处连续.
由偏导数定义可得
\[
f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (0, 0) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 0) - f (0 , 0)}{x - 0} = 0, \quad f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (0, 0) = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (0 , y) - f (0 , 0)}{y - 0} = 0.
\]
代入可知， \(\lim_{\substack{x\to 0\\ y\to 0}}\frac{f(x,y) - f(0,0) - f_x'(0,0)x - f_y'(0,0)y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} = \lim_{\substack{x\to 0\\ y\to 0}}\frac{x^2y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}\sin \left(\frac{1}{x^2 + y^2}\right)\)
其中 \(\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}\sin \left(\frac{1}{x^2 + y^2}\right)\) 是有界的（不难看出 \(\left|\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}\sin \left(\frac{1}{x^2 + y^2}\right)\right| \leq 1\)），可知 \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^2 \frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} \sin \left(\frac{1}{x^2 + y^2}\right) = 0\)，则 \(f(x, y)\) 在点 \((0,0)\) 处可微.
最后，检验 \(f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)\) 与 \(f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)\) 在点 \((0,0)\) 处是否连续：
当 \((x,y)\neq (0,0)\) 时，
\[
\begin{array}{l} f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = 2 x y \sin \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right) + x ^ {2} y \cos \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right) \left[ - \frac {2 x}{\left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \right] \\ = 2 x y \sin \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right) - \frac {2 x ^ {3} y}{\left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \cos \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right) \\ \end{array}
\]
在路径 \( y = x \) 上 \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x,x) = 2x^{2}\sin \left(\frac{1}{2x^{2}}\right) - \frac{1}{2}\cos \left(\frac{1}{2x^{2}}\right) \)，显然，当 \( x \to 0 \) 时 \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x,x) \) 的极限不存在.
则 \(\lim_{\substack{x\to 0\\ y\to 0}}f_x'(x,y)\) 不存在，可知 \(f_x'(x,y)\) 在点 \((0,0)\) 处不连续.
类似地，当 \((x,y)\neq (0,0)\) 时， \(f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) = x^{2}\sin \left(\frac{1}{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right) - \frac{2x^{2}y^{2}}{\left(x^{2} + y^{2}\right)^{2}}\cos \left(\frac{1}{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right)\) ，同样可以检验 \(\lim_{\substack{x\to 0\\ y\to 0}}f_y'(x,y)\) 不存在，则 \(f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)\) 在点 \((0,0)\) 处也不连续.
综上所述， \( f(x,y) \)  在点  \( (0,0) \)  处可微但  \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y) \)  与  \( f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) \)  在点  \( (0,0) \)  处不连续，故选（C）.

D _ {t} = \left\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leq y \leq \sqrt {t x - x ^ {2}}, 0 \leq x \leq t \right\} = \left\{(x, y) \mid x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leq t x, y \geq 0 \right\}

f (t) = \iint_ {D _ {t}} \frac {r d r d \theta}{\left(1 + r ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {t \cos \theta} \frac {r d r}{\left(1 + r ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(1 - \frac {1}{1 + t ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta}\right) d \theta
\]
\[
= \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1}{1 + t ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta} d \theta = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1}{\sec^ {2} \theta + t ^ {2}} \sec^ {2} \theta d \theta
\]

命题①：由于 \(f(x)\) 在 \([1, +\infty)\) 上连续，可知对于反常积分 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty} f(x) dx\) 来说，\(+\infty\) 是唯一的瑕点。又由于 \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} = -2 < -\frac{3}{2}\)，可知，当 \(x\) 足够大时，有 \(\frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} < -\frac{3}{2}\)，整理得 \(\ln f(x) < -\frac{3}{2} \ln x = \ln x^{-\frac{3}{2}}\)，则有 \(0 < f(x) < \frac{1}{x^2}\)（\(\ln f(x)\) 有意义，说明 \(f(x) > 0\)）。而 \(\int_1^{+\infty} \frac{1}{x^{\frac{3}{2}}} dx\) 收敛，可知 \(\int_1^{+\infty} f(x) dx\) 也收敛。命题①正确。
命题②：由于 \(f(x)\) 在 \([1, +\infty)\) 上连续，可知对于反常积分 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty} f(x) dx\) 来说，\(+\infty\) 是唯一的瑕点。又由于
\(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} = 0 > -1\)，可知，当 \(x\) 足够大时，有 \(\frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} > -1\)，整理得 \(\ln f(x) > -\ln x = \ln x^{-1}\)，则有 \(f(x) > \frac{1}{x}\). 而 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty} \frac{1}{x} dx\) 发散，可知 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty} f(x) dx\) 也发散. 命题②正确.
命题③：令 \( f(x) = \frac{1}{(x + 1)\ln^2(x + 1)} \)，不难检验 \( \int_{1}^{+\infty} f(x) dx \) 收敛，但 \( \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{-\ln(x + 1) - 2\ln(\ln(x + 1))}{\ln x} = -1 \)。可知，当 \( \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} = -1 \) 时，反常积分 \( \int_{1}^{+\infty} f(x) dx \) 是有可能收敛的。命题③错误。
命题④: 由于 \(f(x)\) 在 \((0,1]\) 上连续, 可知对于积分 \(\int_0^1 f(x) dx\) 来说, 0 是唯一可能的瑕点. 由于 \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} = -\frac{1}{2} > -\frac{3}{4}\), 可知, 存在 \(\delta > 0\), 当 \(x \in (0, \delta)\) 时, 有 \(\frac{\ln f(x)}{\ln x} > -\frac{3}{4}\), 整理得 \(\ln f(x) < -\frac{3}{4} \ln x = \ln x^{-\frac{3}{4}}\), 则有 \(0 < f(x) < \frac{1}{x^4}\) ( \(\ln f(x)\) 有意义, 说明 \(f(x) > 0\)). 而 \(\int_0^1 \frac{1}{x^3} dx\) 收敛, 可知 \(\int_0^1 f(x) dx\) 也收敛. 命题④正确.
综上所述，有一个命题是错误的，故选（A）.

questions.stem: 设 \(A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 2 & a & -a - 2 \\ 3 & 2a + 1 & -4 \end{pmatrix}, B = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & b \\ a & b - 1 \\ 7 & 2 \end{pmatrix}\), 若矩阵方程 \(AX = B\) 有解且解不唯一, 则 \(X = (\quad)\)

solution.analysis_md:
令  \( \mathbf{X}=(x_{1},x_{2}),\mathbf{B}=(\beta_{1},\beta_{2}) \) ，则  \( Ax_{i}=\beta_{i},i=1,2 \) ，则  \( x_{i} \)  是线性方程组  \( Ax=\beta_{i} \)  的解.
对增广矩阵 \((\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B})\) 做初等行变换：
\[
(\mathbf {A}, \mathbf {B}) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 & 2 & - 1 & 3 \\ 2 & a & - a - 2 & a \\ 3 & 2 a + 1 & - 4 & 7 \end{array} \right) \rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 & 2 & - 1 & 3 \\ 0 & a - 4 & - a & - a - 6 \\ 0 & 2 a - 5 & - 1 & - 2 \end{array} \right) \rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 3 & b \\ - 6 & - b - 1 \\ - 2 & 2 - 3 b \end{array} \right).
\]
要使得 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{B}\) 有解且不唯一，则有 \(|\mathbf{A}| = 0\) ，即 \(2a^{2} - 6a + 4 = 0\) ，解得 \(a = 1\) 或 \(a = 2\)
将 \(a = 1\) 代入可得 \((\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B})\rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & -1\\ 0 & -3 & -1\\ 0 & -3 & -1 \end{array} \right|\left| \begin{array}{ccc}3 & b\\ -5 & -b - 1\\ -2 & 2 - 3b \end{array} \right|\) ，不难看出，此时必有 \(r(\mathbf{A}) = 2,r(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B}) = 3\) ，则矩阵方程 \(\mathbf{AX} = \mathbf{B}\)
无解，不符合题意.
将 \(a = 2\) 代入可得
\[
(\mathbf {A}, \mathbf {B}) \rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c c c}1&2&- 1&3&b\\0&- 2&- 2&- 4&- b - 1\\0&- 1&- 1&- 2&2 - 3 b\end{array}\right)\rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c c c}1&2&- 1&3&b\\0&- 1&- 1&- 1&- 2&2 - 3 b\\0&0&0&0&5 b&- 5\end{array}\right).
\]
可知当且仅当 \(b = 1\) 时，有 \(r(\mathbf{A}) = r(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B}) = 2\) ，矩阵方程 \(\mathbf{AX} = \mathbf{B}\) 有解且不唯一.
将 \(a = 2, b = 1\) 代入，再进一步对增广矩阵做初等行变换化为行最简形可得
\[
(\mathbf {A}, \mathbf {B}) \rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c c c}1&2&- 1&3&1\\0&- 1&- 1&- 2&- 1\\0&0&0&0&0\end{array}\right)\rightarrow \left(\begin{array}{c c c c c}1&0&- 3&- 1&- 1\\0&1&1&2&1\\0&0&0&0&0\end{array}\right).
\]
可知 \(\left( \begin{array}{c}3\\ -1\\ 1 \end{array} \right)\) 是 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 的基础解系， \(\left( \begin{array}{c} - 1\\ 2\\ 0 \end{array} \right)\) 和 \(\left( \begin{array}{c} - 1\\ 1\\ 0 \end{array} \right)\) 分别为 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}\) 和 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}\) 的特解.
则 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \beta_{1}\) 和 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x} = \beta_{2}\) 的通解分别为 \(\mathbf{x}_{1} = k_{1}\left( \begin{array}{c}3\\ -1\\ 1 \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1\\ 2\\ 0 \end{array} \right)\) 和 \(\mathbf{x}_2 = k_2\left( \begin{array}{c}3\\ -1\\ 1 \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1\\ 1\\ 0 \end{array} \right)\)，其中 \(k_{1},k_{2}\) 为任意常数.
故 \(\mathbf{X} = (x_{1},x_{2}) = \left( \begin{array}{cc}3k_{1} - 1 & 3k_{2} - 1\\ -k_{1} + 2 & -k_{2} + 1\\ k_{1} & k_{2} \end{array} \right)\) ，其中 \(k_{1},k_{2}\) 为任意常数.
故选（A）.

questions.stem:
设 \(A\) 为 \(m \times n\) 矩阵, \(B\) 为 \(n \times m\) 矩阵, \(BA = E\), 其中 \(E\) 为 \(n\) 阶单位矩阵, 则下列说法中正确的有 ( ) 个 ① \(BA\) 的行向量组与 \(A\) 的行向量组等价; ② \(AB\) 的列向量组与 \(A\) 的列向量组等价;
③对任意 \(n\) 阶矩阵 \(C\), 齐次线性方程组 \(Cx = 0\) 与 \(ACx = 0\) 同解.

solution.analysis_md:
由于 \(BA = E\)，可知 \(r(BA) = n\)，则有 \(r(A) \geq n, r(B) \geq n\)，又由于 \(r(A)\) 和 \(r(B)\) 都不会超过 \(n\)，可知 \(r(A) = n, r(B) = n\)。
可知 \(r\left( \begin{array}{c}A\\ BA \end{array} \right)\geq n\) ，又由于 \(\left( \begin{array}{c}A\\ BA \end{array} \right)\) 是 \((m + n)\times n\) 矩阵，则 \(r\left( \begin{array}{c}A\\ BA \end{array} \right)\) 不会超过 \(n\) ，可知 \(r\left( \begin{array}{c}A\\ BA \end{array} \right) = n = r(A) = r(BA)\) ，从而 \(BA\) 的行向量组与 \(A\) 的行向量组等价，命题①正确.
对任意 \(n\) 阶矩阵 \(\mathbf{C}\), 齐次线性方程组 \(\mathbf{Cx} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解显然都是 \(A\mathbf{Cx} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解. 任取 \(A\mathbf{Cx} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解 \(\alpha\), 则有 \(A\mathbf{C}\alpha = \mathbf{0}\). 由于 \(r(A) = n\), 可知齐次线性方程组 \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 仅有零解. 而由 \(A\mathbf{C}\alpha = \mathbf{0}\) 可知, \(C\alpha\) 就是 \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 的一个解, 则 \(C\alpha = \mathbf{0}\). 可知 \(\alpha\) 也一定是 \(C\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解. 综上所述, 齐次线性方程组 \(C\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(A\mathbf{C}\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}\) 是同解的. 命题③正确.
下面来判断命题②: 由于 \(r(B) = r(B^T) = n\), 其中 \(B^T\) 为 \(m \times n\) 矩阵. 经过和命题③的讨论类似的过程可以得到齐次线性方程组 \(B^T A^T y = 0\) 和 \(A^T y = 0\) 同解, 则 \(B^T A^T\) 行向量组与 \(A^T\) 的行向量组等价, 也即 \(AB\) 的列向量组与 \(A\) 的列向量组等价. 可知, 命题②也是正确的.
综上所述，三个命题都是正确的，故选（D）.

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 为 \(3 \times 2\) 矩阵, \(B\) 为 \(2 \times 3\) 矩阵, \(BA = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 3 \\ 2 & 2 \end{pmatrix}\), 则 \(|AB + 2E| = (\quad)\)

solution.analysis_md:
\( \left|\lambda E-BA\right|=\left|\begin{matrix}\lambda-1&-3\\ -2&\lambda-2\end{matrix}\right|=\lambda^{2}-3\lambda-4=(\lambda-4)(\lambda+1) \) ，则BA的两个特征值是4,-1.下面说明4,-1也是AB的特征值：
设 \(\lambda\) 为 \(BA\) 的一个非零特征值，\(\alpha\) 为 \(BA\) 属于特征值 \(\lambda\) 的特征向量，则 \(BA\alpha = \lambda \alpha\)。在该等式两边同时左乘 \(A\) 可得 \(ABA\alpha = A(\lambda \alpha)\)，即 \(AB(A\alpha) = \lambda(A\alpha)\)。由于 \(\lambda \neq 0\)，则 \(BA\alpha = \lambda \alpha \neq 0\)，进而有 \(A\alpha \neq 0\)，则 \(\lambda\) 也是 \(AB\) 的特征值，\(A\alpha\) 为对应的特征向量。
综上所述，BA 的非零特征值一定是 AB 的非零特征值，则 4, -1 也是 AB 的特征值.
又由于 \(r(AB) \leq r(A) \leq 2\)，可知 \(AB\) 不满秩，则 \(0\) 也是 \(AB\) 的特征值，可知 \(AB\) 的三个特征值为 \(4, -1, 0\)，\(AB + 2E\) 的特征值为 \(6, 1, 2\)，故 \(|AB + 2E| = 12\)。故选（C）.

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x) \) 二阶可导, 满足 \( \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{f(x) \sin x - x^2}{x^3} = 1 \), 则曲线 \( y = f(x) \) 在 \( x = 0 \) 处的曲率为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
由泰勒公式可得，当 \(x \to 0\) 时，
\[
f (x) \sin x = \left(f (0) + f ^ {\prime} (0) x + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)\right) \left(x - \frac {1}{6} x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)\right)
\]
\[
= f (0) x + f ^ {\prime} (0) x ^ {2} + \left(\frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} - \frac {f (0)}{6}\right) x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right).
\]
代入等式 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)\sin x - x^2}{x^3} = 1\) 可知
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (0) x + f ^ {\prime} (0) x ^ {2} + \left(\frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} - \frac {f (0)}{6}\right) x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right) - x ^ {2}}{x ^ {3}}
\]
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (0) x + [ f ^ {\prime} (0) - 1 ] x ^ {2} + \left(\frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} - \frac {f (0)}{6}\right) x ^ {3} + o (x ^ {3})}{x ^ {3}} = 1.
\]
则 \(f(0) = f'(0) - 1 = 0, \frac{f''(0)}{2} - \frac{f(0)}{6} = 1\)，解得 \(f'(0) = 1, f''(0) = 2\)。
则曲线 \( y = f(x) \) 在 \( x = 0 \) 处的曲率 \( k = \frac{|f''(0)|}{\left[1 + (f'(0))^2\right]^{\frac{3}{2}}} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \).

solution.analysis_md:
先求函数的驻点： \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l}f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y) = \left(1 - x^{2}\right)e^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}} = 0\\ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) = 2y - \frac{2}{y} = 0 \end{array} \right.\)

再判断 \(f(x,y)\) 在上述驻点处是否取极值：
\[
f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = \left(x ^ {3} - 3 x\right) e ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}, f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 0, f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 2 + \frac {2}{y ^ {2}}.
\]
对驻点(1,1): \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(1,1) = -2e^{-\frac{1}{2}}, B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(1,1) = 0, C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(1,1) = 4^{\prime}, AC - B^{2} < 0\)，则点(1,1)不为极值点.
对驻点 \((1, - 1)\) ： \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(1, - 1) = -2e^{-\frac{1}{2}},B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(1, - 1) = 0,C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(1, - 1) = 4^{\prime},AC - B^{2} <   0\) ，则点 \((1, - 1)\) 不为极值点.
对驻点 \((-1,1)\) ： \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(-1,1) = 2e^{-\frac{1}{2}},B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(-1,1) = 0,C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(-1,1) = 4^{\prime},AC - B^{2} > 0\) ，则点 \((-1,1)\) 为极值点.
对驻点 \((-1, - 1)\) ： \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(-1, - 1) = 2e^{-\frac{1}{2}},B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(-1, - 1) = 0,C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(-1, - 1) = 4^{\prime},AC - B^{2} > 0\) ，则点 \((-1, - 1)\) 为极值点.
综上所述， \( f(x,y) \)  的极值点个数为 2.

questions.stem: 设 \(D\) 是由曲线 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = \sqrt{xy}\) 和圆 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) 及两个坐标轴在第一象限内所围成的平面区域, 求 \(\iint_{D} \frac{2xy}{(x^{2} + y^{2})^{2}} \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{d}y\).

solution.analysis_md:
将曲线 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = \sqrt{xy}\) 化为极坐标可得 \(r^2 = \sqrt{r\cos\theta r\sin\theta}\)，即 \(r = \sqrt{\cos\theta\sin\theta}\)，第一象限内 \(\theta\) 的范围为 \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\).
则积分区域 \(D\) 用极坐标可表示为 \(\left\{(r, \theta) \mid \sqrt{\cos \theta \sin \theta} \leq r \leq 1, 0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\right\}\)，用极坐标计算积分可得
原式 \(= \iint_{D}\frac{2r\cos\theta r\sin\theta}{r^{2}} rdrd\theta = \iint_{D}2\cos \theta \sin \theta \frac{1}{r} drd\theta\)
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} 2 \cos \theta \sin \theta d \theta \int_ {\sqrt {\cos \theta} \sin \theta} ^ {1} \frac {1}{r} d r = - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos \theta \sin \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) d \theta .
\]
其中
\[
\begin{array}{l} - \int \cos \theta \sin \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) d \theta = \int \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) d \left(\frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) - \frac {1}{2} \int \cos^ {2} \theta d (\ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta)) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) - \frac {1}{2} \int \cos^ {2} \theta \frac {\cos^ {2} \theta - \sin^ {2} \theta}{\cos \theta \sin \theta} d \theta \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) - \frac {1}{2} \int \left(\frac {\cos^ {3} \theta}{\sin \theta} - \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) d \theta \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) - \frac {1}{2} \int \left(\frac {\cos \theta}{\sin \theta} - 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) d \theta \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta) - \frac {1}{2} \ln \sin \theta + \frac {1}{2} \sin^ {2} \theta + C \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln \cos \theta - \frac {1}{2} \sin^ {2} \theta \ln \sin \theta + \frac {1}{2} \sin^ {2} \theta + C. \\ \end{array}
\]
则原式 \(= -\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos \theta \sin \theta \ln (\cos \theta \sin \theta)d\theta\)
\[
= \left(\frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} \theta \ln \cos \theta - \frac {1}{2} \sin^ {2} \theta \ln \sin \theta + \frac {1}{2} \sin^ {2} \theta\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} = \frac {1}{2}.
\]

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x,y) \) 具有二阶连续的偏导数, \( g(r,\theta)=f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta) \), 满足 \( \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial r^{2}}+\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial g}{\partial r}+\frac{1}{r^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial\theta^{2}}=r^{2} \), 求 \( \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y^{2}} \).

solution.analysis_md:
由复合函数求导法则可知
\[
\frac {\partial g}{\partial r} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \cdot \cos \theta + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \cdot \sin \theta , \frac {\partial g}{\partial \theta} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \cdot r (- \sin \theta) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \cdot r \cos \theta .
\]
再求导可得，
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial r ^ {2}} = \cos \theta \cdot \frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime}\right) + \sin \theta \cdot \frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime}\right) \\ = \cos \theta \cdot \left(f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot \cos \theta + f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot \sin \theta\right) + \sin \theta \cdot \left(f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot \cos \theta + f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot \sin \theta\right) \\ = \cos^ {2} \theta \cdot f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} + 2 \cos \theta \sin \theta f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + \sin^ {2} \theta \cdot f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime}. \\ \end{array}
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial \theta^ {2}} = - r \sin \theta \cdot \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime}\right) - r \cos \theta \cdot f _ {1} ^ {\prime} + r \cos \theta \cdot \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime}\right) - r \sin \theta \cdot f _ {2} ^ {\prime}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} = - r \sin \theta \cdot \left(- f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot r \sin \theta + f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot r \cos \theta\right) - r \cos \theta \cdot f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \\ + r \cos \theta \cdot \left(- f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot r \sin \theta + f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \cdot r \cos \theta\right) - r \sin \theta \cdot f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \\ = r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} - r ^ {2} 2 \cos \theta \sin \theta \cdot f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + r ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta \cdot f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} - r \cos \theta \cdot f _ {1} ^ {\prime} - r \sin \theta \cdot f _ {2} ^ {\prime}. \\ \end{array}
\]
代入可知 \(\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial r^2} +\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial g}{\partial r} +\frac{1}{r^2}\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial\theta^2} = f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\big(r\cos \theta ,r\sin \theta \big) + f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\big(r\cos \theta ,r\sin \theta \big) = r^2\)
令 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = r\cos \theta, \\ y = r\sin \theta \end{array} \right.\) 可得 \(f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,y) + f_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x,y) = x^{2} + y^{2}\).
即 \(\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x^2} +\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial y^2} = x^2 +y^2\)

（Ⅰ）由复合函数求导法则可知：
\[
y ^ {\prime} = \frac {d y}{d x} = \frac {d y}{d t} \frac {d t}{d x} = \frac {d y}{d t} (1 + \cos x);
\]
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {d ^ {2} y}{d x ^ {2}} = \frac {d}{d x} \left[ \frac {d y}{d t} (1 + \cos x) \right] = \frac {d}{d x} \left(\frac {d y}{d t}\right) (1 + \cos x) + \frac {d y}{d t} \frac {d}{d x} (1 + \cos x)
\]
\[
= \frac {d}{d t} \left(\frac {d y}{d t}\right) \frac {d t}{d x} (1 + \cos x) - \frac {d y}{d t} \sin x = \frac {d ^ {2} y}{d t ^ {2}} (1 + \cos x) ^ {2} - \frac {d y}{d t} \sin x.
\]
代入可知 \(\frac{d^2y}{dt^2} (1 + \cos x)^2 -\frac{dy}{dt}\sin x + \tan \frac{x}{2}\cdot \frac{dy}{dt} (1 + \cos x) - (1 + \cos x)^2 y = 0\)
其中 \(\tan \frac{x}{2} \cdot (1 + \cos x) = \frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x} (1 + \cos x) = \sin x\)，则
\[
\frac {d ^ {2} y}{d t ^ {2}} (1 + \cos x) ^ {2} - (1 + \cos x) ^ {2} y = 0, \text {即} \frac {d ^ {2} y}{d t ^ {2}} - y = 0.
\]
这是一个二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程，特征方程为 \(r^2 - 1 = 0\)，解得 \(r_1 = 1, r_2 = -1\)，其通解为 \(y = C_1 e^{t} + C_2 e^{-t}\)，即 \(y = C_1 e^{x + \sin x} + C_2 e^{-x - \sin x}\).
由于 \(y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 2\)，代入可知 \(C_1 + C_2 = 1, 2C_1 - 2C_2 = 2\)。
解得 \(C_1 = 1, C_2 = 0\)，故 \(y(x) = e^{x + \sin x}\)。
（Ⅱ）由旋转体的体积公式可得，曲线 \( y = (2 + x + x\cos x)f(x) \) 与直线 \( x = \pi, x = 0 \) 及 \( x \) 轴所围成的平面图形绕 \( y \) 轴旋转一周所得的旋转体体积为
\[
V = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x (2 + x + x \cos x) f (x) d x = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (2 x + x ^ {2} (1 + \cos x)) e ^ {x + \sin x} d x
\]
\[
= 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left(\left(x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\prime} e ^ {x + \sin x} + x ^ {2} \left(e ^ {x + \sin x}\right) ^ {\prime}\right) d x = 2 \pi x ^ {2} e ^ {x + \sin x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} = 2 \pi^ {3} e ^ {\pi}
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(D_{n}\) 为区间 \([0,2n\pi]\) 上曲线 \(y = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{x}{2}}\sqrt{\left(\frac{x}{2\pi} - \left[\frac{x}{2\pi}\right]\right)}\sin x\) 与 \(x\) 轴所围成的平面区域, 其中 \([x]\) 表示不超过 \(x\) 的最大整数, \(D_{n}\) 绕 \(x\) 轴旋转一周所得的旋转体体积为 \(V_{n}\), 求 \(V_{n}\) 及 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{V_n}{\mathrm{e}^{2n\pi}}\).

solution.analysis_md:
先求函数的定义域, 由于 \(\frac{x}{2\pi} - \left[\frac{x}{2\pi}\right]\) 的取值是非负的, 可知函数 \(e^{\frac{x}{2}}\sqrt{\left(\frac{x}{2\pi} - \left[\frac{x}{2\pi}\right]\right)}\sin x\) 的定义域是使得 \(\sin x\) 的取值非负的 \(x\) 的范围, 可知 \(2k\pi \leq x \leq 2k\pi + \pi, k = 0, 1, 2, \ldots, n - 1\).
则由旋转体的体积公式可得
\[
V _ {n} = \pi \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \int_ {2 k \pi} ^ {2 k \pi + \pi} e ^ {2} \sqrt {\left(\frac {x}{2 \pi} - \left[ \frac {x}{2 \pi} \right]\right)} \sin x \Bigg) ^ {2} d x = \pi \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \int_ {2 k \pi} ^ {2 k \pi + \pi} e ^ {x} \left(\frac {x}{2 \pi} - \left[ \frac {x}{2 \pi} \right]\right) \sin x d x.
\]
容易检验 \(\frac{x}{2\pi} -\left[\frac{x}{2\pi}\right]\) 和 \(\sin x\) 都以 \(2\pi\) 为周期，可知
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {2 k \pi} ^ {2 k \pi + \pi} e ^ {x} \left(\frac {x}{2 \pi} - \left[ \frac {x}{2 \pi} \right]\right) \sin x d x = \int_ {0} ^ {t = x - 2 k \pi} e ^ {t + 2 k \pi} \left(\frac {t + 2 k \pi}{2 \pi} - \left[ \frac {t + 2 k \pi}{2 \pi} \right]\right) \sin (t + 2 k \pi) d t \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} e ^ {t + 2 k \pi} \left(\frac {t}{2 \pi} - \left[ \frac {t}{2 \pi} \right]\right) \sin t d t. \\ \end{array}
\]
